The '''Blue Belt''' is a {{Rare}} [[Belts|Belt]]. It can be upgraded into the {{Item|Brown Belt}}, and is a direct upgrade from the {{Item|Green Belt}}. This item is automatically {{DG|Soulbound}} upon receiving it.

== Obtaining ==
The '''Blue Belt''' is obtainable from {{NPCSprite|Master Tao}} after reaching 4000 points in the {{Zone|Dojo}}.

Once obtained, it can be repurchased from {{NPCSprite|Rusty}} for {{Coins|4,000,000}}.

== Trivia ==
*Together with its predecessors and successors, it has an uncommon limit to how many [[Star Upgrades]] can be applied.
*The price of this item at {{NPCSprite|Rusty}} is not affected by the {{Item|Shady Ring}} and its upgraded versions.
